label: Peplink MAX BR1 Pro 5G mobile router
description: 5G mobile router with SpeedFusion bonding, dual-band 2x2 Wi-Fi 6, and three Ethernet ports: one 2.5G WAN plus two GbE LAN, with the WAN re-taskable as a third LAN.
notes: Vendor figures from the BR1 Pro 5G datasheet: Ethernet WAN port **1 / 0 (2.5G)**, LAN port **2 / 3 (GE)**, **Router Throughput 1 Gbps**, Wi-Fi AP Yes, **PoE Input Yes**. **The WAN port is 2.5G while the LAN ports are gigabit**, so a 2.5G uplink cannot be passed to a 2.5G host without crossing the 1 Gbps router ceiling anyway. (This entry previously listed a 100 Mbps and a 2.5 Gbps *wireless* interface - port speeds that had leaked into the radio rows of an earlier parse; the radios are Wi-Fi 6 and the 5G modem, and both are now recorded as such.)
